title: Barbie
lede: Greta Gerwig's film about the doll, followed from what people looked up to what they borrowed.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Barbie: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order, not proof that the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly)

steps.title: People look up Barbie, the doll
